title: Fast-rising artist KRU 5IFTY 2WO releases debut track “Man Dey a Road”
htmlContent:
American Based artist KRU 5IFTY 2WO is a talented Afrobeat singer and songwriter who is bringing a new kind of heat to the rap industry.KRU 5IFTY 2WO created a sound that he has crafted into something that truly defines him with his recent track, “Man Dey a Road.”

KRU 5IFTY 2WO's newest single, “Man Dey a Road,” showcases his ability to go bar for bar, keeping his lyrics thrilling and entertaining to the listener. As usual, he delivers his verses with a unique style that displays a smooth vocal. KRU 5IFTY 2WO again adds much replay matter to the track, making it refreshing.
